facts.title: Framer × AI: design with an agent
facts.description: An agent that designs alongside you on the Framer canvas. You bring the idea and keep steering while it builds the real layout.

research.name: Framer x Paper Shaders
research.note: A Framer-built landing page that uses a fluted glass shader over a blurred image in its hero.

effects: Fluted glass refraction shader over a blurred photo in the hero

unverified: That the hero effect comes from Paper Shaders is inferred from the page title; the shaders are public in github.com/paper-design/shaders (Apache-2.0), which should be researched instead of this page.
The page shows no date, so lastUpdated is unknown.
Whether this page is a remixable Framer template or a one-off demo was not established.
